images.name: 초승달 물결
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one exceptional high-fantasy MMORPG weapon design concept image, a wide landscape 3:2 composition. EXACTLY TWO full-length weapons only: an unstrung-or-fine-string functional bow on the LEFT and a tall magic staff on the RIGHT, separated by generous empty space. Both entire weapons visible from top tip to bottom tip, large in frame, orthographic-like three-quarter product presentation, same scale of craft, crisp material and silhouette detail. No swords, people, hands, captions, letters, labels, watermark, UI, border, or background moon. Plain very dark navy background. Noble blue-moon regalia with asymmetric sweeping curves, elaborate but clearly legible architectural shapes and elegant open negative spaces. The blue moon is the primary physical emblem: a large luminous BLUE moonstone or moon-shaped structure built into each weapon, readable at thumbnail scale, not merely a tiny engraved symbol. Deep cobalt and royal-blue translucent moonstone and opalescent azure surfaces dominate; pearl-blue cutting highlights, very restrained fine platinum-gold joining lines; almost no grey metal. No ordinary grey weapon painted blue. Fine engraved star paths only secondary. Luxurious, graceful, powerful, otherworldly; no industrial mechanical parts, no animal heads, skulls, red blood, excessive smoke, huge bloom that conceals structure, or thicket of tiny symmetrical spikes. Design both weapons from scratch, independently shaped within a matching collection inspired by flowing blue moonlight. The bow must retain an identifiable central handgrip and coherent limb/string path; the staff must retain a usable long grip. Precise full-silhouette concept art with subtle material depth, not a flat icon. Pair 01 — Crescent tide. Bow: an astonishing offset C-shaped longbow whose upper cobalt limb unfurls as one long breaking wave and lower limb curls back into a shorter crescent; a broad opaline BLUE crescent surrounds an open oval just above the grip, and a single long blue drop hangs below. Staff: a long gently S-curved shaft rising into a huge sideways crescent of blue moonstone, with two flowing blade-like wave ribbons wrapping at different heights around its open center. Express liquid moonlight with broad continuous curved surfaces, asymmetry and spacious elegant gaps.

visual_review.note: 초승달을 크게 드러낸 물결형 활과 넓은 두 갈래 곡선의 초승달 지팡이.
